name: Fujiwara no Atsuyori
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 82); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 12th century.

poems.title: How sad and gloomy is the world
poems.author: Fujiwara no Atsuyori
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 82
poems.text:
How sad and gloomy is the world,
This world of sin and woe!
Ah! while I drift along Life’s stream,
Tossed helpless to and fro,
My tears will ever flow.
